in_marathi.name: Devraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Deva (God) and Raja (ruler). This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture, signifying the one who rules over the gods or is a god himself.
